name: @wasm-runtime/lucide-plec
description: Unofficial experimental PLEC integration for Lucide icons; not affiliated with or supported by Lucide.

scripts.build: node scripts/generate-icons.mjs && yarn --cwd ../.. exec tsc -p packages/lucide-plec/tsconfig.json
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/generate-icons.mjs && yarn --cwd ../.. exec tsc -p packages/lucide-plec/tsconfig.json --noEmit
